params_toml:
# Exp 5 campaign settings, read by scripts/exp5/launch.py.
#
# Every number a stage needs lives here, so the file in the commit that a
# manifest records says how a sweep ran. A setting that is commented out is
# UNSET: the launcher refuses (or, with --skip-blocked, leaves out) every job
# that needs it, and names it. Change a setting only before a stage starts;
# a CSV written under other settings is refused on resume (its .argv.json).
#
# Order of the stages and what each one fills in below:
#   ttl     -> [pilot_outputs] session_ttl_s   (2 x the p95 fit time, rounded up)
#   knee    -> [pilot_outputs] knee_s, stress_s (where served fraction stops rising;
#                                                stress = half the knee, rounded to 5 s)
#   sstar   -> [pilot_outputs] s_star           (the S* tool's S per N)
#   batch1  -> the studies, at the values above
#
# Sources: FeRRy_Build_Plan.html (Experiments, Study overview, Addendum),
# Experiment_4_Run_Guide.md sections 2.6-2.8, HERMES_Configuration_Reference.md
# sections 17-20.

[campaign]
# REQUIRED. The base seed of every trial in the campaign (trial seed =
# sha256(base_seed | cell | trial)). 42 is Exp 4's; the pilots take a seed of
# their own (Phase 4 spec, decision 7). Same seed in every stage keeps the
# studies' arms paired.
base_seed = 20261005
n_missions = 4                # the headline's mission count (build plan, Experiments)
regime = "jittery"
# 0 = the fixed 100 m realism field (the recorded behaviour; density rises with N).
# 6 = grow the field with N at N = 6's density (--h1-field-ref-n 6; 5.9 and 5.11).
# One value for the whole campaign: the knee and S* must be measured on the
# field the studies fly. Fixed (decided 5 Oct 2026): FerrySim's N = 12 training
# cells fly the fixed field, and the re-pin reads the stack's N = 12 knee onto
# them, so the stack must fly the same field.
field_ref_n = 0
# The deadline law of the FeRRy arms (F, FX, FB+, F-cov, F-cap, F-prio, F+L1 and
# the FQ arms). The build plan defines F with the multiplicative law; F-add, the
# additive law, is Study 5.2's ablation. --deadline-law is one driver setting,
# so the launcher passes it per job: the H and D arms keep the driver's default
# (additive, the recorded law). Decided 5 Oct 2026.
ferry_arm_deadline_law = "multiplicative"
# --footprint-probe on every batch-1 trial (processes and peak memory, 5.11). It
# only reads memory, so a trial is the same with it; it is on everywhere so the
# studies' shared cells (5.3, 5.9, 5.11 (b), 5.14 at N = 6) are one job.
footprint = true

[machine]
# Parallel jobs (one runner process each). The scheduler also keeps the sum of
# the jobs' estimated memory under mem_budget_gb, and the devices of the
# running jobs (each a TensorFlow process that trains) under
# max_device_processes: on 8 physical cores (16 threads) CPU binds first.
# 36 = six N = 6 jobs, which ran cleanly in the launcher's test (5 Oct).
max_jobs = 6
max_device_processes = 36
mem_budget_gb = 75.0          # of 95 GB on this machine
# Measured 5 Oct 2026 with the footprint probe (N = 6, 1 MB, the canonical
# model): a device peaks at about 431 MB, the cluster 395 MB, a mule 44 MB, a
# whole trial 2.9 GB. The build plan's 1.6 GB per process came from another
# host; these keep a margin over the measurement.
gb_per_tf_process = 0.6       # the cluster and each device
gb_per_light_process = 0.3    # the runner and each mule
# Per-process thread caps, set for every job and recorded in the manifest. The
# Exp 4 parallel sweep used the first three. Keep them fixed for the whole
# campaign: they change wall-clock fit time (hence the TTL pilot), and TF's
# thread count can change the model's last bits.
[machine.threads]
OMP_NUM_THREADS = "2"
TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS = "2"
TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS = "1"
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1"

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pilot outputs. Fill these from the pilots' reports, then commit.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
[pilot_outputs]
# session_ttl_s = { "6" = 0.0, "12" = 0.0, "18" = 0.0, "24" = 0.0 }
# knee_s        = { "6" = 0.0, "12" = 0.0, "18" = 0.0, "24" = 0.0 }
# stress_s      = { "6" = 0.0, "12" = 0.0, "18" = 0.0, "24" = 0.0 }
# s_star        = { "6" = 2, "12" = 2, "18" = 2, "24" = 2 }
# At the measured payload (18.8 KB), for Study 5.4:
# knee_meas_s   = { "6" = 0.0 }
# stress_meas_s = { "6" = 0.0 }

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage ttl: the session-TTL pilot (fit_time_probe.py at each N, with as many
# trials side by side as the scheduler will run at that N).
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
[ttl]
N = [6, 12, 18, 24]
fits = 4

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage knee: H1 budget sweeps on wide (Run Guide 2.6/2.7), the Phase 4
# pilots' common flags, K = 1. Needs session_ttl_s.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
[knee]
# [N, payload] per sweep: 1 MB at every N the studies fly (18 and 24 for 5.11 (b)
# and 5.9), and the measured payload ("measured", 18.8 KB) at N = 6 for 5.4.
cells = [[6, 1000000], [12, 1000000], [18, 1000000], [24, 1000000], [6, "measured"]]
n_trials = 20                 # pilots use n = 20
# The budgets to sweep per N (one CSV per point), around the stand-ins: N = 6
# prior knee 90 s / stress 45 s; N = 12 FerrySim 120/180 s; N = 24 FerrySim
# scale family 350/525 s. Fixed 5 Oct 2026, before the pilot ran.
budgets_s = { "6" = [30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 150], "12" = [60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 240], "18" = [120, 180, 240, 300, 360, 450], "24" = [175, 262, 350, 437, 525, 700] }
# The knee rule, pre-registered 5 Oct 2026 before the pilot ran (Run Guide 2.6:
# "where the served fraction stops rising"): per (N, payload), the smallest
# budget whose mean `metric` reaches `plateau_share` of the largest mean over
# the grid. The stress budget is half the knee, rounded to 5 s (Run Guide 2.7).
# `launch.py report knee` applies it. update_yield is the mean number of
# updates merged per round (the served share times N).
metric = "update_yield"
plateau_share = 0.95

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage sstar: the age cap S* per N at the knee and stress budgets (Run Guide
# 2.7; D4 in the build plan). Needs knee_s and stress_s.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
[sstar]
N = [6, 12, 18, 24]
payload_bytes = 1000000

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage batch1 (the 8 Oct split). Needs session_ttl_s, knee_s, stress_s, s_star.
# Budgets and S are keyed by the cell's N at every K ("the budget at each N",
# 5.11). Plan arms (F, FX, F+L1) fly --age-cap-missions S; H and D arms do not.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
[s53]                         # whole-scheduler comparison, core cells
arms = ["F", "FX", "H1", "D1", "D2", "D3", "D4"]
d4_faithful = true            # also D4 with its own merge (agg:fedex), job "D4fedex"
N = [6]
K = [1, 3]
budgets = ["knee", "stress"]
n_trials = 20
payload_bytes = 1000000       # the plan arms' pilots' payload: the cap and coverage bind there

[s59]                         # scale, core cells (N = 6 cells are shared with s53)
arms = ["F", "FX", "H1", "D3", "D4"]
N = [6, 12, 24]
K = [1]
budgets = ["knee"]
n_trials = 20
payload_bytes = 1000000

[s511b]                       # scaling with mules: weak (6 per mule) and strong (N = 12)
arms = ["F", "FX", "H1", "D4"]
cells = [[6, 1], [12, 2], [18, 3], [12, 1], [12, 3]]   # [N, K]
budgets = ["knee"]
n_trials = 20
payload_bytes = 1000000

[s511a]                       # decision cost in FerrySim (in process, stub trainer)
cells = ["jit-n6-90", "jit-n12-120", "scl-n24-350", "scl-n48-680", "scl-n96-1330"]
policies = ["FX"]
episodes = 20
modes = ["auto", "subsets", "local"]   # planner left alone; stop subsets forced; local search forced
workers = 4

[s514]                        # component ablations: F against F with one switch flipped
N = 6
budgets = ["knee", "stress"]
n_trials = 40
payload_bytes = 1000000       # held fixed at 1 MB by the study
# The variants are fixed in launch.py (S514_VARIANTS): cap S*, whole stops,
# local search, weighted coverage rank, cap S* + 1, cap off, hover off, and
# F / F+L1 on the seconds backhaul (F+L1 needs the adaptive backhaul).
